text.p: Average yields at auctions of Ukrainian six-month, nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills were down from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Six-month bills eased to 19.93 percent from 19.96 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 25.39 percent from 26.11 percent, 12-month bills slimmed to 26.02 percent from 26.96 percent, and 18-month bills fell to 28.69 from 30.46 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.60 million UAH 12.60 million UAH
Amount sold 8.36 million UAH 10.02 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.60 million UAH 9.11 million UAH
The central bank sold 83,610 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 32.00 million UAH 11.00 million UAH
Amount sold 32.00 million UAH 11.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 26.89 million UAH 9.20 million UAH
The central bank sold 320,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 45.40 million UAH 90.00 million UAH
Amount sold 45.40 million UAH 90.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 36.04 million UAH 70.92 million UAH
The central bank sold 454,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills was not announced.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 37.00 million UAH 6.80 million UAH
Amount sold 37.00 million UAH 6.80 million UAH
Actual amount raised 25.88 million UAH 4.67 million UAH
The central bank sold 370,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
